drivingQuestion: Who is the tanna behind the mishna's requirement to lift the barrel rather than move the stone?
outcomeNote: the identification with Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel stands

segments.he: אָמַר רַבָּה בַּר בַּר חָנָה אָמַר רַבִּי יוֹחָנָן: רַבָּן שִׁמְעוֹן בֶּן גַּמְלִיאֵל הִיא. דִּתְנַן: הַבּוֹרֵר קִטְנִית בְּיוֹם טוֹב, בֵּית שַׁמַּאי אוֹמְרִים: בּוֹרֵר אוֹכֶל וְאוֹכֵל. וּבֵית הִלֵּל אוֹמְרִים: בּוֹרֵר כְּדַרְכּוֹ, בְּחֵיקוֹ וּבַתַּמְחוּי.
segments.en: «Rabba bar bar Ḥana said» that «Rabbi Yoḥanan said: It is Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel. As we learned» in a mishna: With regard to «one who selects legumes on a Festival,» separating edible and inedible, «Beit Shammai say: He selects food and eats» it immediately and leaves the waste. «And Beit Hillel say: He selects in his usual manner,» and may even remove the waste and leave the food, «in his lap or in a large vessel.»

segments.he: וְתַנְיָא, אָמַר רַבָּן שִׁמְעוֹן בֶּן גַּמְלִיאֵל: בַּמֶּה דְּבָרִים אֲמוּרִים — שֶׁהָאוֹכֶל מְרוּבֶּה עַל הַפְּסוֹלֶת. אֲבָל פְּסוֹלֶת מְרוּבָּה עַל הָאוֹכֶל — דִּבְרֵי הַכֹּל בּוֹרֵר אוֹכֶל.
segments.en: «And it was taught» in a baraita that «Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel said: In what» case «are these matters,» the dispute between Beit Shammai and Beit Hillel, «stated:» In a case «where the» quantity of the «food is greater than the» quantity of the «waste. However, if» the quantity of the «waste is greater than the» quantity of the «food, everyone agrees» that «one selects» the «food» to avoid the exertion involved in removing the waste, which itself may not be moved. The same is true here. He moves the barrel and not the stone, which is like waste.

segments.he: וְהָא הָכָא, דְּכִי אוֹכֶל מְרוּבֶּה עַל הַפְּסוֹלֶת דָּמֵי!
segments.en: The Gemara asks: «And here,» in the case of the barrel, «isn’t it comparable to» a case where «the food» is «greater than the waste,» as the barrel, which is food, is bigger and heavier than the stone. In addition, it is easier to move the stone. Nevertheless, he is not permitted to do so, in accordance with the opinion of Beit Hillel.

segments.he: הָכָא נָמֵי, כֵּיוָן דְּאִי בָּעֵי לְמִישְׁקַל, לָא מִשְׁתְּקִיל לֵיהּ יַיִן עַד דְּשָׁקֵיל לַהּ לְאֶבֶן — כִּפְסוֹלֶת מְרוּבָּה עַל הָאוֹכֶל דָּמֵי.
segments.en: The Gemara answers: «Here, too, since if he wants to take» the wine, the «wine cannot be taken until he removes the stone,» the legal status of the stone is «like» that of «waste» which is «greater» in quantity «than the food,» and it cannot be likened to the case of selecting. In this case, he is unable to move the barrel without moving the stone.
